description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for the iMessage channel in the OpenClaw project, including parsing allowlist entries, managing policies, creating UI inputs, and setting up wizard proxies.

methods.name: parseIMessageAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Parses a raw string of allowlist entries for iMessage, validating chat IDs, GUIDs, identifiers, and handles.

methods.name: promptIMessageAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure the iMessage allowlist, with instructions and existing configuration.

methods.name: createIMessageCliPathTextInput
methods.description: Creates a UI input component for specifying the iMessage CLI path.

methods.name: createIMessageSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Creates a setup wizard proxy for the iMessage channel, managing configuration status, inputs, and policies.
